kaikki_vikisozluk.e: فِتَكْر or فُتَكْر or فِتْكَر or فِتْكِر • (fitakr or futakr or fitkar or fitkir) m (plural فِتَكْرُون (fitakrūn) or فُتَكْرُون (futakrūn) or فِتْكَرُون (fitkarūn) or فِتْكِرُون (fitkirūn))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Classical Syriac ܦܬܟܪܐ (pəṯaḵrā, “idol, likeness”), from Old Persian 𐎱𐎫𐎡𐎣𐎼 (p-t-i-k-r /⁠patikaraʰ⁠/, “sculpted image; likeness”), something execrable in Christian circles, hence the meaning in Arabic.
g: calamity, formidable thing, something nasty, misfortune
